original_defendo.sensitivity_improvement_definition: Increase greater than zero centimetres from baseline
original_defendo.safety_interpretation: Sensory changes must be interpreted with symptoms and ocular health; cross-trial pain comparison is not established.

defendo_extension.design: Observational prospective extension of the original treated DEFENDO cohort

defendo_extension.sap_full_analysis_set: Enrolled participants attending month 24, month 30, or both
defendo_extension.sap_analysis_status: Exploratory, hypothesis-generating; descriptive analyses without type I error control
defendo_extension.sap_missing_data: Observed-case analysis; missing categorical observations reported but excluded from percentage denominators
inference_prohibited: Do not use original treated 37 as extension enrollment.
Do not convert responder-conditioned maintenance into an all-original-patient response rate.
Do not infer a durable untreated effect from one cenegermin course when subsequent care or retreatment was allowed.
Do not treat a posted-results date as an inspected numeric result.

orunea.inference: Competitive development constrains a broad healing thesis but does not supply a clinical result or establish RM inferiority.

intended_product_claims.patient_problem: Persistent harmful hypoesthesia after corneal injury or surgery
intended_product_claims.decision_judgment: Define useful protective function and symptoms in the relevant injury context; transient postoperative sensory reduction alone is not a validated commercial indication.
Cenegermin supplies an active benchmark; future contribution might involve function, safety, burden or cost, without requiring superiority on every endpoint.

intended_product_claims.patient_problem: Persistent epithelial defect or broad wound healing
intended_product_claims.decision_judgment: Treat healing separately from sensory repair and optical function; Orunea makes active current competition explicit.

intended_product_claims.patient_problem: Painful dry eye or neuropathic corneal pain
intended_product_claims.decision_judgment: An increased mechanosensory reading is not automatically a benefit; distinguish protection from unwanted sensitization.
